body:
incident-bot: ALERT: hosted-api p99 latency > 12s and request queue growth detected in us-west (~5m). auto-escalation triggered :rotating_light:
ryan_sre: seeing a big inflight queue on the hosted endpoints, queue depth +12k in last 4m. p95 2.3s -> 6.8s, p99 8s -> 18s.
maria_prod: customers reporting timeouts and increased 504s, support ticket surge. Which pools are impacted?
samir_infra: GPU pool 'dw-heap-usw-1' saturated, provisioner stuck creating new nodes due to cloud quota errors (RateLimitExceeded). autoscaler logs show repeated CreateInstance failures.
jonathan_oncall: switching to incident channel. I’m taking lead. First mitigation: start hard-fallback routing to cpu-backed smaller models for non-critical routes. Can we enable now?
ryan_sre: we can flip fallback policy via console route overrides. Doing a partial route override for /v1/generate non-enterprise to model 'ggml-small' (cpu) to reduce pressure. Will add 10% traffic initially.
(10:02) samir_infra: provisioner logs: 
```
ERROR CreateInstance: RateLimitExceeded: quota projects/ABC/computeInstances: createInsufficientQuota
Retrying in backoff...
```
We’re hitting regional GPU quota. Request to cloud quota team submitted but not immediate.
maria_prod: notifying top-10 customers about degraded performance and mitigation. Amy, can you post an update in status page?
amy_support: posting now. message: "We are seeing elevated latency and timeouts in US-West for hosted API. Engineers are actively mitigating; potential temporary fallbacks to smaller models and throttling. Will update in 15m." :white_check_mark:
ryan_sre: enabling aggressive prefix/kv caching on heavy chat routes (10s TTL) to cut token load on infer nodes. Applying recipe now.
jonathan_oncall: reducing per-API-key burst limits temporarily to blunt the org-level fanout. Pushing a policy change to limit concurrent inflight requests per key to 40 -> 10. This will increase 429s but stabilize latency.
samir_infra: autoscaler shows leader failing to reconcile new pool due to instance template hitting deprecated image -> long retry loops. patching instance template to use current image tag. After patch, new instance creation should resume if quota allowed.
(10:17) incident-bot: NOTE: Route override applied: /v1/embeddings -> fallback-small-cpu (10% traffic), /v1/generate non-enterprise -> fallback-small-cpu (10%).
maria_prod: Customer Impact: multiple customers in marketing campaign region seeing p99 bursts and 504s. Potential SLA degradations for 2 customers. Opening priority support escalations.
yan? (typo in original, removed)
ryan_sre: monitoring dashboard: queue length stabilized a bit after route override and throttles but still elevated. p99 dropped to ~9s. backoff from exponential retries visible in client logs.
jonathan_oncall: oncall handoff note: I'll call for help from capacity team and cloud quotas. @samir, escalate to cloud quota ops and request temporary quota bump or move some capacity to another region and reroute traffic.
samir_infra: raised a P1 with cloud partner, asked for emergency GPU quota. Meanwhile spinning up additional thin-provisioned spot GPUs in eu-west and starting cross-region routing for low-latency tolerant traffic.
amy_support: status update posted to status.redwood.com: "Mitigations in place: throttling, small-model fallbacks, cache increases. Working on GPU provisioning. Expect update in 30m."
jonathan_oncall: preparing handoff to night oncall in 40m. writing runbook notes: cause = provisioner hit quota + deprecated template -> create failures -> GPU pool saturation -> request queue growth -> elevated p95/p99 and 504s. Actions taken: route overrides, throttles, cache, small-model fallback, instance-template patch, cloud quota request, cross-region routing.
ryan_sre: quick sanity checks: running `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=inference -o wide` shows a few pods in CrashLoopBackOff pre-patch but main service still accepts connections. Also adjusted eviction settings to avoid mass restarts.
(10:42) incident-bot: New alert: provisioner backoff ended, some instance creations succeeded (3 new GPUs), qp backlog decreased 25% in 5m.
maria_prod: good. Update support queues and reach out to top impacted customers with ETA ~45m.
samir_infra: still watching cloud quota response. If quota bump not approved, we will widen cross-region fallback and increase CPU fallback to 30% traffic.
jonathan_oncall: next steps: 1) keep throttles in place, 2) broaden fallback if needed, 3) coordinate with cloud for quota, 4) prepare postmortem template. I'll hand off to night oncall @ryan_sre at 11:00. Please ack.
ryan_sre: ack. Will monitor and escalate to leadership if cross-region migration needed.
amy_support: posted follow-up to status: "Partial recovery observed. Continued mitigation and capacity work ongoing. Expect next update in 30 minutes."
(11:02) jonathan_oncall: handoff complete. Leaving notes in incident tracker: priority=P1, root-cause in infra provisioner + cloud quota, mitigation = throttling + small-model fallbacks + caching + instance-template fix.
ryan_sre: continuing monitoring; timeline: expect full recovery in ~1-3h depending on quota.
(11:15) incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: p99 down to 4.5s, queue depth trending down. Closing alert to oncall channel; incident remains open for postmortem and follow-ups."
